short: SDIO 1.8V island: TXS02612 splits 1.8V / 3.3V sides
long: microSD: SDIO runs at 1.8 V on the SoM side (typed sd_bus level in the netlist) — keep the TXS02612 translator mid-block: 1.8V side faces the SoM, 3.3V card side faces the slot; bus length match <= 2.5 mm to CLK.

short: power inlet: VBUS->TVS->bulk->+VIN; CC pair to FUSB302
long: PD power inlet: keep the VBUS path (receptacle -> TVS -> bulk -> +VIN) in one corner so the +VIN plane spreads from a single point; CC1/CC2 route to the FUSB302 (usb_pd block, anchored next to this inlet). PLAN.md round 5: a TPS25940-class eFuse lands between receptacle and bulk — reserve space for it here.

short: USB-C OTG: 90R HS pair short + matched; ESD at conn
long: USB-C OTG: the 90R D+/D- pair wants the shortest matched run to its SoM pins; USBLC6-2SC6 ESD array within ~10 mm of the receptacle; VBUS source switch beside the connector.

short: USB-C OTG: 90R HS pair short + matched; ESD at conn
long: USB-C OTG: the 90R D+/D- pair wants the shortest matched run to its SoM pins; USBLC6-2SC6 ESD array within ~10 mm of the receptacle; VBUS source switch beside the connector.

short: USB-C OTG: 90R HS pair short + matched; ESD at conn
long: USB-C OTG: the 90R D+/D- pair wants the shortest matched run to its SoM pins; USBLC6-2SC6 ESD array within ~10 mm of the receptacle; VBUS source switch beside the connector.

short: LCD FFC exit; backlight boost loop tight
long: 40-pin LCD FFC: cable exits over the board edge; keep the SY7201ABC backlight boost loop (L/D/C) tight and away from the FFC signal rows; RGB888 bus is single-ended bank-34 3V3 — bus-route together.

short: camera FFC: 3 CSI-2 pairs 100R to J3 side
long: RPi camera FFC: 3 MIPI CSI-2 pairs at 100R differential to the J3 side of the SoM (bank 35, 2.5 V VCCO per the expect= notes) — keep the run to the J3 strip short.

short: 4 TMDS pairs 100R; companion IC at connector
long: 4 TMDS pairs at 100R differential, intra-pair skew <= 0.15 mm (native/src/constraints.cpp); place TPD12S016PWR directly behind the receptacle so all pairs pass straight through.

short: 4 TMDS pairs 100R; companion IC at connector
long: 4 TMDS pairs at 100R differential, intra-pair skew <= 0.15 mm (native/src/constraints.cpp); place M24C02-WMN6TP directly behind the receptacle so all pairs pass straight through.

short: PMOD pair on gated +3V3_PMOD rail
long: Two PMOD sockets side by side; both fed from the gated +3V3_PMOD rail (SY6280 cell in bringup_modules) — route the gated rail once, star at the sockets.

short: PMOD pair on gated +3V3_PMOD rail
long: Two PMOD sockets side by side; both fed from the gated +3V3_PMOD rail (SY6280 cell in bringup_modules) — route the gated rail once, star at the sockets.

short: 10 load switches: gated-rail star points
long: 10 SY6280 load-switch cells; each gated rail (+3V3_CAM, +3V3_HDMI_RX, +3V3_HDMI_TX, +3V3_LCD, +3V3_PMOD, +3V3_SD, +3V3_USER_LED, +5V_HDMI_TX, +5V_LCD, +5V_USB) stars from its switch — place this block centrally so every gated rail leaves toward its module without crossing the others.

short: rail-EN DIPs + PG LEDs: human access
long: Rail-enable DIP switches + power-good LEDs: face them where fingers and eyes reach them with the mezzanine mounted — keep clear of the SoM shadow.

short: JTAG/SWD headers vertical: probe clearance
long: JTAG (2x7 2 mm) + SWD (2x5 1.27 mm) headers mate vertically — any top-side spot works; keep cable/probe clearance and the boot DIP reachable.

short: magnetics keep-out: no planes line-side; 100R MDI
long: Magnetics isolation: void ALL planes under the HX5008 line side + Bob-Smith network (CHASSIS_GND moat to the RJ45); MDI pairs are 100R differential. RJ45 itself is an author-declared deferral (expect rj45_connector) — the dashed reservation is its landing zone.

short: bank-35 IO header: VADJ LDO copper
long: TLV75725PDYDR VADJ LDO dissipates ~0.32 W at the declared 0.4 A — give its EP pad a ground pour.

short: 2 bucks: thermal copper + vias; keep SW loops tight
long: Buck thermal (worst-case declared draws): LM61460AANRJRR +5V_REG ~1.52 W; LM61460AANRJRR +3V3_REG ~0.82 W. Pour copper on the SW/PGND side, stitch vias under the packages, keep each SW node loop minimal.

short: INA3221 shunts sit IN the rail path
long: Power monitor: the shunt resistors are in series with the rails — the rails must physically route through this block; place it between the regulators and the loads, Kelvin-connect the sense pairs.

short: USB-UART conn deferred; TPs on TX/RX
long: CP2102N UART bridge: its USB connector is an author-declared deferral (expect usb_uart_connector) — the block reserves edge space for it; TX/RX test points stay probe-able.

short: FUSB302 beside inlet: short CC stubs
long: FUSB302 PD controller: anchored beside the pd_input receptacle so CC1/CC2 stay short stubs; I2C runs to the SoM J1 side.

short: LEDs + buttons human-facing
long: User LEDs + buttons: human-facing — keep at the accessible S side, clear of the PMOD cable shadow.

short: 58 test points board-wide
long: 58 test points board-wide (test-point gate): spread them with probe clearance as the blocks settle; none may end up under the SoM.
